recommendation.headline: Fight the chargeback with UPS delivery and signature confirmation showing delivery to the buyer's address.
recommendation.rationale: The buyer claims merchandise not received, but UPS tracking and signature confirmation prove the package was delivered to the shipping address on 418 Alder St, Denver, CO and signed for by Whitfield. Additionally, customer messaging shows the buyer acknowledged the delivery on September 26. Since seller protection is eligible and full tracking with signature is available, we have a very strong case to win.

evidence.summary: UPS tracking 1Z84A9E70347215522 shows delivery on 2026-09-26 to 418 Alder St, Denver, CO 80203, signed by WHITFIELD.
UPS delivery record shows signature by WHITFIELD at the delivery address matching the order shipping address.

recommendation.response_to_paypal: The item was shipped via UPS (tracking number 1Z84A9E70347215522) to the shipping address provided at checkout (418 Alder St, Apt 3, Denver, CO 80203). UPS records confirm delivery on September 26, 2026, and the package was signed for by Whitfield. Furthermore, the buyer messaged us on September 26 confirming receipt of the out-for-delivery notice.
risks: The buyer may claim the signature belongs to someone else, though the address matches and carrier records show proper delivery.
